g.title: py_soc
g.text: Bold = module, grey = instance in py_soc.sv. Purple = AXI4-Lite (32-bit), thick = bus master path, red = interrupts, orange = boot. Every window is 256 bytes (MASK 0xFFFF_FF00) except EXT (64 KB).

g.title: cgen
g.text: = CPU clock, runs all of py_soc

g.title: rst
g.text: CPU reset = rst_n AND CPU PLL locked
sys_rst_n = CPU reset and no watchdog reset
then a fresh boot from flash

g.title: p_ext
g.text: out: m_ext_axil_aw*, w*, ar*, bready, rready (to the system)
in: m_ext_axil_*ready, b*, r* (from the system)
